_comment: Non-turret structures. nav_cost: how many metres of detour the swarm will accept before bashing through (x10 internally). climbable when the corpse pile next to it reaches climb_height.

structures.name: Wall
structures.role: Cheap barrier. The swarm paths around it, or bashes through.

structures.name: Blast Door
structures.role: Heavy armoured door. Maulers deal x4 damage to doors.

structures.name: Floodlight
structures.role: Lights the ground around it. Turrets cannot see unlit targets at night (M5).

structures.name: Harvester Bay
structures.role: Launches harvester drones that collect Biomass from corpses in range. Drones also clear corpse piles off your walls.
